location.en: Maple Bay Family Clinic, on the phone
location.zh: 楓灣家庭診所，電話預約

goal.en: Book a doctor's appointment and find the fastest way to be seen.
goal.zh: 預約看診，並找出最快能看到醫生的方法。

background: small family clinic reception area, light wood front desk, a row of padded waiting chairs, potted plants by the window, pale green walls, bright morning light

intro.en: Your throat has been sore for three days, and it's not getting better.
intro.zh: 你的喉嚨已經痛了三天，一直沒有好轉。

intro.en: Time to see a doctor. You call the clinic near your studio.
intro.zh: 該去看醫生了。你打電話到套房附近的診所。

lines.en: Good morning, Maple Bay Family Clinic. This is Linda. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 早安，楓灣家庭診所，我是琳達。有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

choices.en: Hi. I'd like to make an appointment to see a doctor, please.
choices.tip: I'd like to make an appointment. 一句話說清楚來意，國外看診大多要先預約。

choices.en: Hi. I want to hang a number. Can I see a doctor today, please?
choices.zh: 嗨。我想掛號。今天可以看醫生嗎？

lines.en: Hang... up? Oh, okay. Sorry to bother you, then!
lines.zh: 掛……電話？喔，好吧。那不打擾您了！

story.en: Click. Linda thinks you want to hang up, so she does. You stare at your phone and dial again.
story.zh: 喀。琳達以為你要掛電話，就真的掛了。你盯著手機，只好重撥一次。

fail.why: 「掛號」不能直譯成 hang a number，hang 會讓人聯想到 hang up（掛電話）。在英語國家看診要說 I'd like to make an appointment.

choices.en: Oh, I'm fine, thank you. And how are you this morning?
choices.zh: 喔，我很好，謝謝。那你今天早上過得好嗎？

lines.en: I'm... good, thanks? Um, did you need something today?
lines.zh: 我……很好，謝謝？呃，請問您今天有什麼需要嗎？

story.en: After a round of polite small talk, Linda has to answer another line. You stay on hold for fifteen minutes.
story.zh: 客套寒暄一輪之後，琳達得先接另一通電話。你在線上等了十五分鐘。

fail.why: How can I help you? 是問你需要什麼，不是問你好不好。不用回 I'm fine，直接說來意：I'd like to make an appointment.

lines.en: Let me check... The first opening with Dr. Patel is next Tuesday at two.
lines.zh: 我查一下……帕特爾醫師最早的空檔是下星期二兩點。

choices.en: That's a bit late for me. Do you have anything earlier?
choices.zh: 對我來說有點晚。有更早的時段嗎？
choices.tip: Do you have anything earlier? 不用重複整句，anything earlier 就能問有沒有更早的時段。

choices.en: Tuesday is too late. Do you have more early time? Like today?
choices.zh: 星期二太晚了。有更早的時間嗎？像是今天？

lines.en: More early time? Oh, earlier on Tuesday? Sure, I have eight a.m.
lines.zh: 更早的時間？喔，星期二早一點？可以，有早上八點。

story.en: Linda moves you to 8 a.m. next Tuesday. Earlier, yes. Still six days away.
story.zh: 琳達幫你改到下星期二早上八點。確實比較早，但還是要等六天。

fail.why: 「更早」是 earlier，不是 more early。單音節或 -y 結尾的形容詞，比較級直接變化：early → earlier、late → later。

choices.en: Next Tuesday? That's ridiculous. I'm sick now!
choices.zh: 下星期二？太誇張了吧。我現在就在生病耶！

lines.en: I understand. But that is our first opening.
lines.zh: 我了解。但那就是我們最早的空檔。

story.en: Linda books you for Tuesday without another word. She never mentions the faster option.
story.zh: 琳達二話不說幫你排了星期二，完全沒提還有更快的辦法。

fail.why: 嫌時間太晚可以理解，但說 ridiculous 很沒禮貌，對方也不會想多幫你。客氣地問：Do you have anything earlier?

lines.en: Nothing earlier this week, I'm afraid.
lines.zh: 恐怕這禮拜沒有更早的了。

lines.en: But we have walk-in hours every morning from eight to ten. No appointment needed.
lines.zh: 不過我們每天早上八點到十點有現場看診，不用預約。

choices.en: So I can just come in without an appointment? That's great.
choices.zh: 所以我不用預約，直接過去就可以？太好了。
choices.tip: So I can just...? 用自己的話重述一次，確認你真的聽懂了 walk-in 的意思。

choices.en: Walk in? But my place is far. Can I take a bus there instead?
choices.zh: 走路去？可是我家很遠。可以改搭公車去嗎？

lines.en: A bus is fine! Walk-in just means... never mind. Any way is fine.
lines.zh: 搭公車可以啊！walk-in 的意思是……算了，怎麼來都可以。

story.en: You spend the morning planning the perfect bus route. You arrive at eleven, and walk-in hours are over.
story.zh: 你花了整個早上研究最佳公車路線。十一點抵達時，現場看診時段已經結束了。

fail.why: walk-in 是「不用預約、直接上門」，跟走路無關。搭公車、開車去都算 walk-in。

choices.en: Great. Can I come in the evening instead? Clinics in Taiwan open late.
choices.zh: 太好了。可以改晚上去嗎？台灣的診所都開到很晚。

lines.en: In the evening? Oh, no. We close at five. Then the earliest is still next Tuesday.
lines.zh: 晚上？喔，不行，我們五點就關門了。那最早還是只能下星期二。

story.en: Since evenings are out, you're back to next Tuesday. Your throat would like to file a complaint.
story.zh: 既然晚上不行，你又回到下星期二。你的喉嚨很想提出抗議。

fail.why: 台灣很多診所有夜診，但楓灣的診所通常傍晚就關門。要把握對方提供的時段：早上八點到十點的 walk-in。

lines.en: Exactly. Just bring your ID and your insurance card.
lines.zh: 沒錯。記得帶身分證件和保險卡就好。

lines.en: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.zh: 還有其他需要幫忙的地方嗎？

choices.en: No, that's all. Thanks so much for your help, Linda.
choices.zh: 沒有了，就這樣。非常謝謝你的幫忙，琳達。
choices.tip: No, that's all. 是結束對話的標準回答，再加一句道謝，喊出對方名字更親切。

choices.en: No more. Trouble you so much today. Thank you, thank you.
choices.zh: 沒有了。今天麻煩你了。謝謝、謝謝。

lines.en: Trouble? Oh, no, you're no trouble at all! Is everything okay?
lines.zh: 麻煩？喔，不會，您一點都不麻煩！一切都還好嗎？

story.en: Linda thinks you feel bad about calling and keeps reassuring you. The call ends ten minutes later, with both of you apologizing.
story.zh: 琳達以為你打這通電話很過意不去，一直安慰你。十分鐘後才掛電話，兩個人還在互相道歉。

fail.why: 「麻煩你了」直譯成 Trouble you 不是英文說法，聽起來像你給人添了大麻煩。道謝就說 Thanks so much for your help.

choices.en: No. That's all. I have to go now, okay? Bye-bye.
choices.zh: 沒有。就這樣。我現在要走了，好嗎？掰掰。

story.en: Linda wonders if she said something wrong. When you walk in the next morning, the greeting feels a little stiff.
story.zh: 琳達懷疑自己是不是說錯話了。隔天早上你走進診所，她打招呼的樣子有點僵。

fail.why: 一連串短句又急著結束，聽起來很不耐煩。結束通話前先道謝：No, that's all. Thanks so much for your help.

lines.en: The next morning, you arrive at 7:55, first in line.
lines.zh: 隔天早上，你七點五十五分就到了，排在第一個。

story.en: You see Dr. Patel by 8:15. Sometimes the fastest appointment is no appointment at all.
story.zh: 八點十五分你就見到帕特爾醫師了。有時候最快的預約，就是不用預約。

notes.en: I'd like to make an appointment.
notes.explain: 國外看醫生大多要先預約。make an appointment 用在看醫生、看牙醫、找專業人士；和朋友約見面不用 appointment，說 make plans 就好。

example.en: I'd like to make an appointment with the dentist.

notes.explain: anything earlier / anything later 是問其他時段的省力說法，訂位、預約都通用。

example.en: Friday doesn't work for me. Do you have anything later in the week?
example.zh: 星期五我不行。這禮拜有晚一點的時段嗎？

notes.explain: walk-in 指不用預約、直接上門，跟走路無關。walk-in hours 是開放現場看診的時段，walk-in clinic 是不用預約的診所。

example.en: The clinic takes walk-ins from eight to ten.
example.zh: 這間診所八點到十點開放現場看診。

notes.en: Thanks so much for your help.
notes.explain: 「麻煩你了」不能直譯成 Trouble you，英文會說 Thanks so much for your help. 或 I really appreciate it.

example.en: Thanks so much for your help. I really appreciate it.
example.zh: 非常謝謝你的幫忙，真的很感謝。

notes.explain: 台灣很多診所有夜診，晚上下班也能看病。楓灣的家庭診所通常白天看診、傍晚就關門，急著看病就利用早上的 walk-in 時段。

example.zh: 你們現場看診的時間是幾點？
